svg.title: Which flows the NSGs allow
svg.desc: You reach the VMs over SSH only through bas-hub, from the portal on port 443, because nsg-web and nsg-app allow SSH only from the Bastion subnet; a tunnel client reaches port 80 on vm-web but never SSH. Port 80 from vm-web to vm-app is allowed by nsg-app, while port 80 from vm-app to vm-web is denied by nsg-web.
